purpose: Bind one red test per criterion of US-19005 (FBS-230), each driving bin/rcf.js over fixture git repositories with a bare local remote and servers on 127.0.0.1, so the Build hand makes them green against the pre-merge Finalise rule of ADR-4151.
title: Pre-merge Finalise and loopback targets: rcf build finalise promotes on the PR branch, accepts a loopback report naming engine, port and served sha, refuses an uncommitted report, keeps provenance, confirms on main after a merge commit, keeps --allow-pre-merge as a no-op; rcf verify run records the loopback fields; the shipped text says so

testCases.description: rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> on a feature or hotfix branch whose HEAD contains the report head exits 0 with no flag, writes verified on the branch, prints the verified-from line, no off-trunk refusal, no C-26 line, spawns nothing but git
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20001-1: over DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW: MERGE/PASS at H touching both criteria and TEST: PASS with a passing test-strength record at H, and no rcf/verify-reports/, finalise FBS-001 --ci-run run-7 exits 0 with the complete line, writes executionStatus complete and changes nothing else in the tree

testCases.description: a committed loopback report (each loopback form) naming target.engine, target.port and target.servedSha equal to headSha promotes: exit 0, verified, no "is loopback"
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20003-2: a committed FAIL or malformed VerifyReport under rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/ leaves finalise output as without it (exit 0, the complete line), and a PASS report never stands in for a missing TEST verdict

testCases.description: a committed loopback report lacking engine, port or servedSha exits 4 with "finalise refused: loopback report target <url> names no target.<field>", FBS byte-identical; guard: a non-loopback report needs none
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20003-2: a committed FAIL or malformed VerifyReport under rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/ leaves finalise output as without it (exit 0, the complete line), and a PASS report never stands in for a missing TEST verdict

testCases.description: a committed loopback report whose target.servedSha is not its headSha exits 4 with "finalise refused: report target.servedSha <sha7> is not the report head <sha7>", FBS byte-identical
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20003-2: a committed FAIL or malformed VerifyReport under rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/ leaves finalise output as without it (exit 0, the complete line), and a PASS report never stands in for a missing TEST verdict

testCases.description: rcf verify run --hand verifier --url <loopback> --engine <name> --served-sha <HEAD> records target { kind, url, engine, port, servedSha }
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/loopback-target-run.test.js::AC-19005-5: rcf verify run --hand verifier --url <loopback-url> --engine <name> --served-sha <committed HEAD> records target { kind "url", url, engine, port, servedSha } in rcf/verify-reports/<fbs-id>/<head12>.json

testCases.description: rcf verify run --served-sha other than the full committed HEAD exits 4 with "verify report refused: --served-sha <value> is not the committed HEAD <sha7>", no report, no probe
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/loopback-target-run.test.js::AC-19005-5: a --served-sha that is not the full sha of the committed HEAD exits 4 with "verify report refused: --served-sha <value> is not the committed HEAD <sha7>", writing no report and sending no probe

testCases.description: rcf verify run --hand with a loopback --url and no --engine or no --served-sha exits 2 naming the flag, no report, no probe
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/loopback-target-run.test.js::AC-19005-5: a loopback --url with --hand exits 2 with "[error] usage --engine <name> is required with --hand and a loopback --url" with no --engine, and "[error] usage --served-sha <sha> is required with --hand and a loopback --url" with no --served-sha, writing no report and sending no probe

testCases.description: a report not committed in HEAD (newest on disk or --report) or differing from its committed bytes exits 4 with the named message, FBS byte-identical; guard: the committed report promotes
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20003-2: a committed FAIL or malformed VerifyReport under rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/ leaves finalise output as without it (exit 0, the complete line), and a PASS report never stands in for a missing TEST verdict

testCases.description: on a branch, a builder Hand-Id equal to verifierId, an over-age report and an uncontained head each exit 4 with their message ("re-verify this head"), FBS byte-identical, nothing but git spawned
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20002-4: an earlier BUILD: tests commit touching test/rcf/a.test.js makes finalise exit 4 "finalise refused: separation FAIL: <s7> BUILD: touches test/rcf/a.test.js (class rcfTest, owned by DEFINE)", and a Hand: mixed commit refuses the same way with the retired-mixed item

testCases.description: verified on the branch, merged with --no-ff, rcf build finalise on main confirms: exit 0, verified-from line, FBS byte-identical, clean tree, nothing but git spawned
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20001-5: run again at the same head or after a FINALISE: status commit, finalise exits 0 with "finalise: FBS-001 complete (unchanged)" and a byte-identical spec file, and after an earlier round closed by REVIEW FINDINGS it judges only the last round and exits 0

testCases.description: rcf build finalise with --allow-pre-merge gives the same exit, write and refusal as without it, one deprecation line, no C-26 output
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-verdicts.test.js::AC-20003-1: each retired flag (--report, --max-report-age 7, --mode deterministic, --url http://localhost:8787, --allow-pre-merge) makes finalise exit 2 with the no-verify-report line, spawn nothing and write nothing

testCases.description: finalise HELP, build HELP, guidance build-cycle, playbook sections 6 and 7, the managed block and the bundle runbook Stage 5 say "on the PR branch before the merge" and name loopback with a served sha; none carries an after-the-merge Finalise shape
testCases.testPointer: test/guidance/build-cycle-0-37.test.js::AC-20401-1: rcf guidance build-cycle carries the five stage headings in order, TEST running the full RCF suite locally with nothing deployed, FINALISE before the merge writing complete, and a VERIFY (outside the build cycle) section with rcf verify run --record writing verified
